answer: Treat every identity as a vertex in a trust graph, and let acceptance travel by random walks. Walks hop only along edges earned by joint work: each edge is one cracked walnut, a task two strangers complete and both sign. Honest vertices mix freely, so walks spread wide; a swarm clusters tight, and walks inside rarely escape. Each epoch a mixing signal test quarantines vertices trapped in one cluster. An honest agent joins with one edge, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 attack edges into the honest region, one collaboration per fake.
